description: Visitor archetypes spawned by the two prototype-anchor types (shared-web, game-servers), from the §3.2 patience spine. Five-stat unit per §3.1 (Patience/Value/Weight/Loyalty/Fragility); patienceMode per the bundle patienceModel enum; durationClass per §3.1 shapes (Instant=mote circle, Session=dot-with-thread teardrop, BatchJob=square, Resident=hexagon). bounty = expected Value on conversion (§3.1 loop: goal reached with budget left -> convert, pay Value) — doc authors bounty classes only qualitatively ('high value tiny patience'), every scalar is null + _todo until the tuning sheet. Six legibility families (§3.2): Browsers - Buyers - Machines - Amplifiers - Costs - Evaluators.

bounty._todo: §3.2 calls skimmers 'volume, most fragile' — no revenue scalar.

facts: Shared-web render: 'Sparks' — tiny fast cyan darts, high count low value, bursty clumps tied to customer marketing, 'rain on a window' (§3.3).

facts: Budget 1,000ms already docked 300ms for radio latency before your stack spends a millisecond (§3.2).

facts: Trust earns milliseconds: a served-regular arrives with a +1,000ms buffer (§3.2).
Also the game-lobby browser window-shopper archetype (reads the server-browser listing before joining).

facts: Patient per page, punished by your tail: budget refreshes each hop (§3.2, §3.1 tail compounding).

bounty._todo: §3.2: 'high value tiny patience (core tension unit)' — the doc names it THE tension unit but sets no bounty scalar.

facts: The core tension unit: richest bounty riding the shortest fuse (§3.2).

bounty._todo: §3.2: 6,000ms across the full funnel; bounty scalar unauthored.

facts: Traverses the whole funnel — every slow node taxes the same budget (§3.2, §3.1 latency ladder).

bounty._todo: §3.2: 10,000ms then HARD FAIL — binary, no gradual bounce; retryAmplifies risk lives here. Bounty scalar unauthored.

facts: No sigmoid: past budget it simply fails, and machine clients retry — the emergent retry-storm seed (§3.2, §1.3 sim law).

bounty._todo: §3.2: 8,000ms; slow responses CUT THE CRAWL BUDGET — your SEO reach decays with your latency, not theirs. Bounty scalar unauthored.

facts: Patience looks huge but the real cost is the truncated crawl budget — invisible reputation bleed (§3.2).

bounty._todo: §3.2/§3.3 doc all five anchors (2,000ms join, ~90ms ping budget, 80ms rage-quit cliff, 30/80 chip bands, 45-min sessions, parties of five) — no bounty scalar; revenue is per-slot monthly (§3.3).

facts: Two-phase patience: 2,000ms to connect, then permanently ping-bound — 80ms sustained = rage-quit (§3.2).
Parties of FIVE, all-or-nothing: can't get in together, all leave (§3.3).
Delayed bounce: plays badly, leaves angry, and the emptying lobby repels the next player (§3.3 herding).
Render: 'Pawns' — named persistent chunky sprites with nameplate + ping chip (green <30ms, amber <80, red beyond); a leaver stands, shakes its head, walks out, and the other pawns REACT (§3.3).
